summary: The compatible Fe(110) CH* + H* -> CH2* + * electronic barrier is formally registered and the Grade-A transition state is recorded in the Topic-1 workbook.

payload.objective: Register the compatible electronic barrier for the accepted Fe(110) CH* + H* -> CH2* + * DIMER transition state and record it in the Topic-1 TS workbook.
current_evidence: The accepted IS, DIMER TS, and FS final OUTCAR TOTEN values are -372.33497184, -371.78042471, and -371.85016675 eV under fe110_converged_toten_sigma0p20_v1.
All three calculations have the same compatibility fingerprint af46be282c446bc897e5bf8dcef116ae1bf6121446d6f190ef60a768176f9c35.
The hash-bound authoritative gate is VALIDATED_TS and explicitly allows REPORT_FINAL_BARRIER.
Registry barrier fe110_ch_h_to_ch2_9701350_9709074_9622444_sigma0p20 is accepted: forward 0.55454713 eV, reverse 0.06974204 eV, reaction energy +0.48480509 eV.
The Topic-1 workbook contains the CH* + H* -> CH2* row, formula-derived barriers, and appended DIMER/frequency evidence; the formula-error scan returned zero and all sheets passed visual review.
payload.one_executable_step: No further action is required for the electronic-barrier task. Thermochemical corrections require a separate explicit request and consistent IS/TS/FS active-set treatment.
payload.submission_boundary: Do not submit, stop, restart, or resubmit VASP. This record is an electronic barrier only and must not be described as a free-energy barrier or kinetics-ready dataset.
done_when: The compatible final IS/TS/FS energy chain and accepted barrier exist in the project registry.
The Topic-1 TS workbook contains the verified transition-state and barrier record.
The scope remains explicitly limited to electronic energies without ZPE, entropy, or free-energy corrections.
